decision_conditions:
The wording of condition 12 attached to planning permission ref: P2022/4189/FUL, dated 15/06/2023 shall now read as follows:

CONDITION: All inclusive design measures (including the Sesame lift to the front elevation entrance in Goswell Road) identified within the application submission shall be installed and operational prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved. Further details on the following points shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and installed prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved: a) the firefighting strategy and how the needs of disabled people has been addressed including details of refuge areas; b) accessible cycle storage; c) accessible toilet fitout, including details of right hand side and left hand side toilet transfer alternating between ground floor, first floor, and second floor toilets d) door specifications e) mobile scooter storage and charging point The inclusive design measures shall be retained as such in perpetuity. 

REASON: In order to facilitate and promote inclusive and sustainable communities.
description: Non-Material Amendment of Planning permission ref: P2022/4189/FUL, dated: 15/06/2023. The proposed amendment seeks to vary the wording of condition 12.
